AUTH_TENANT_UNRESOLVED: We couldn't identify your organization. Try the link your admin gave you or ask for help.
AUTH_SIGNUP_DISABLED: Public sign-up is disabled. Ask your organization for access.
AUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN: This email is already registered in this tenant
AUTH_DOCUMENT_ID_TAKEN: That ID number (DNI/NIE) is already registered in this tenant.
AUTH_ONBOARDING_MISSING_FIELDS: Some required information is missing to complete onboarding.
AUTH_CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT: The current password is not correct.
AUTH_NEW_PASSWORD_SAME_AS_CURRENT: The new password must be different from the current one.
AUTH_SESSION_NOT_FOUND: Session not found or not yours.
AUTH_MFA_NOT_ACTIVE: MFA is not active for this user
AUTH_API_KEY_INVALID: Invalid, expired or revoked API key
AUTH_MFA_POLICY_ADMIN_ONLY: Only super_admin and tenant_admin can manage the MFA policy.
AUTH_RESET_LINK_USED: This link was already used. Request a new one.
AUTH_RESET_LINK_EXPIRED: This link expired. Request a new one.
AUTH_API_KEY_MISSING_SCOPES: The API key does not have the required scope(s): {detail}
SSO_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_REQUIRED: clientSecret is required the first time you configure the IdP. Paste it from the IdP panel (it will not be shown again).
SSO_OIDC_NOT_ENABLED: This tenant does not have OIDC SSO enabled.
SSO_OIDC_IDP_ERROR: The identity provider returned an error: {detail}
SSO_OIDC_CALLBACK_PARAMS_MISSING: Missing state/code parameters in the callback.
SSO_OIDC_CONFIG_DISABLED_MID_FLOW: The tenant's OIDC config was disabled during the flow.
SSO_OIDC_CONFIG_CHANGED_MID_FLOW: The OIDC config changed during the flow. Retry the login.
SSO_OIDC_ISS_MISMATCH: The id_token iss does not match the configured issuer.
SSO_OIDC_AUD_MISMATCH: The id_token aud does not match the clientId.
SSO_OIDC_NONCE_MISMATCH: The id_token nonce does not match.
SSO_OIDC_EMAIL_MISSING: The IdP did not return a valid email in the id_token. Make sure to include the "email" scope and configure it in the IdP.
SSO_EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: The email "{detail}" does not belong to the domains allowed for SSO in this tenant.
SSO_USER_NOT_PROVISIONED: You don't have an account in this tenant. Ask the admin to enable auto-provisioning or to create your account first.
SSO_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Your account is not active. Contact the tenant admin.
SSO_OIDC_IDP_UNREACHABLE: We couldn't reach the identity provider. Check that the issuer is online and try again.
SSO_SAML_NOT_ENABLED: This tenant does not have SAML SSO enabled.
SSO_SAML_REQUEST_BUILD_FAILED: We couldn't generate the SAML request. Check the IdP configuration.
SSO_SAML_CALLBACK_PARAMS_MISSING: Missing SAMLResponse / RelayState parameters in the callback.
SSO_SAML_CONFIG_DISABLED_MID_FLOW: The tenant's SAML config was disabled during the flow.
SSO_SAML_CONFIG_CHANGED_MID_FLOW: The SAML config changed during the flow. Retry the login.
SSO_SAML_ISSUER_MISMATCH: The SAMLResponse issuer does not match the configured IdP.
SSO_SAML_EMAIL_MISSING: The IdP did not return a valid email in the Assertion. Check the attribute mapping.
SSO_SAML_CONFIG_MISSING: This tenant has no SAML config.
SSO_WP_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Your account is not active. Contact the administrator.
SSO_WP_USER_NOT_PROVISIONED: You don't have an account in Didacta. Ask the administrator to create one for you.
SSO_WP_SHARED_SECRET_REQUIRED: The shared secret is required the first time. Paste it (the same one as in wp-config.php); it will not be shown again.
